audit.summary: All 6 assets are suitable for the Walibi Rhône-Alpes summer 2026 campaign. The collection includes 4 strong experience visuals (attraction photos and lifestyle scenes of rides and family moments), 1 logo, and demonstrates clear thematic alignment with the park's Explorer Adventure, Festival City, and Exotic Island zones. No blockers identified. The logo file wra.svg correctly displays the official Walibi Rhône-Alpes brand wordmark with both the iconic 'WALIBI' text in red and the 'RHÔNE-ALPES' sub-brand identifier. The logo matches the official lockup from brandURL (https://www.walibi.fr/content/experience-fragments/wra/fr/b2c/header/master/_jcr_content/root/header/logo.coreimg.svg/1710343837893/wra.svg) and aligns with the primary color palette (#EE7C1B red-orange tones). No blockers identified.
